newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested.

Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,300 slaughter steers and 200 heifers. 79,200 head confirmed for week to date which includes 15,300 formulated and 700 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 68.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 67.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 975-1050 lbs 67.00. Confirmed - 1,500 Week Ago - 7,000 Year Ago - 65,000
Wk to Date - 79,200 Week Ago - 89,000 Year Ago - 95,300
